# Architecture Gate consumption

Before Analyst decomposition or standalone developer/debugger/coding-agent implementation, inspect
an optional `## Architecture Gate` in the supplied work contract. An absent gate or `Status:
not-required` is backward compatible. When `Mode: the-architect`, only `Status: passed` permits
execution.

Consume and preserve the managed Architect Addendum. Do not repeat portfolio/component-history
research already settled there. Challenge it only when current repository evidence, scope, or safety
conflicts; return that conflict to the control authority/the-architect rather than silently rewriting it.
